title: Open Data API Directory — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Public APIs, schemas, authentication requirements, usage limits, and tested examples. The Open Data API Directory is a field guide to public data on the internet: which APIs exist, what data they serve, how to authenticate, what the rate limits are, and — critically — a tested example call that is verified to work. Dead documentation is the norm for API directories; every entry here carries a last-tested date and the exact request/response from the test, so builders start from working calls, not hopeful docs.

title: Open Data API Directory — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. API record anatomy: {name, base_url, category, auth: none|key|oauth, rate_limit, license, endpoints[]}. Endpoint: {path, method, params (name, type, required, example), response_schema, tested_example {request, status, response_sample, tested_at}}. Reliability practices: test on a schedule; flag deprecations; record error responses (429, 401, 503) with retry guidance; note pagination schemes (cursor vs offset) and their traps. Auth: API keys go in headers, never URLs; OAuth flows documented step by step. License: data license (not API terms) governs reuse — recorded separately per the license database.

demo.title: Execution: identity resolution matching
demo.code: function jw(a,b){a=a.toLowerCase();b=b.toLowerCase();if(a===b)return 1;let m=0;const n=Math.min(a.length,b.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]===b[i])m++;return m/Math.max(a.length,b.length);}const pairs=[['Jon Smith','John Smith'],['Jon Smith','Maria Garcia']];const scored=pairs.map(([x,y])=>({x,y,s:+jw(x,y).toFixed(2)}));J({scored});assert(scored[0].s>scored[1].s,'match');

title: Open Data API Directory — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Tests: completeness test (no entry without a tested example); freshness test (tested_at within the retest window); schema test (response samples validate against declared schemas); determinism test. Limitations: live re-testing needs network and is done by the maintenance process, not in these demos (which use stored pairs); API terms change — recheck before production use. Every entry carries tested_at and tester version.

demo.title: Execution: pipeline stage hashing and replay
demo.code: const crypto=require('crypto');function h(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex').slice(0,8);}const stages=['import','clean','validate','export'];const data='raw-data-v1';let cur=data;const hashes=stages.map(s=>{cur=s+':'+cur;return s+'='+h(cur);});const replay=(()=>{let c=data;return stages.map(s=>{c=s+':'+c;return s+'='+h(c);});})();J({hashes:hashes.length,replayMatch:JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay)});assert(JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay),'replay');
